text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! How was Curren's run, if I may 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, yay♪ Does this put your mind at ease, 
Onii-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, yay♪ Does this put your mind at ease, 
Onee-chan?

She's balancing her social media 
activities with improving her skills. If 
so, then worrying any further might truly 
be unnecessary...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm super happy about the thought, you 
know? Thanks."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right. Let's see what's happening on 
Umastagram...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The comment section looks great♪ Big 
brother, take a look too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The comment section looks great♪ Big 
sister, take a look too!

Prompted by a pleased-looking Curren Chan, 
I took a look at her Umastagram—

"First time watching a race, but it was so 
fun!" "Curren Chan is so cute! Followed!" 
"Looking forward to the next race too♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The comments are up, and people are 
watching my races! Guess that PR effort 
really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I might just dash my way to becoming the 
'most loved Umamusume' in record time...♪

It happened on the way back from Kyoto to 
Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Flash-saaaan♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san. Good afternoon... or rather, 
precisely speaking, good evening, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Either way is fine by Curren♪ Flash-san, 
you really are so punctual~.

(—Eishin Flash. An Umamusume who debuted 
around the same time as Curren Chan and 
has been making waves in the Classic 
route.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Could you, by any chance... happen to be 
jogging right now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The race is coming up, so these are 
the final adjustments.
choice_data_list: No, it's more like you're too close...

text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, she's scheduled to 
run in tomorrow's Japanese Derby. At this 
hour, I would expect her to be resting, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, normally at this time, I ought 
to be resting in preparation for the 
race."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then why?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I'm ashamed to admit it, but I just 
can't control my emotions.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Doing nothing makes me feel uneasy, so I 
received permission for light jogging and 
am running like this.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san did? ...She's usually so cool 
and collected, that's unusual, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I would adhere strictly to the 
schedule, of course. However...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is the Japanese Derby. After 
all... it is truly special."
choice_data_list: It's the stage of dreams, after all
It's the stage of dreams, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
She had a strong showing in her previous 
race, the Satsuki Sho. Even so, with the 
Japanese Derby right before her eyes, it's 
understandable that she'd feel restless.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...We've been standing around talking for 
too long. I'll need to adjust my schedule 
by 3 minutes and 36 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking my leave now. Curren-san, 
Trainer-san, please get home safely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Ah, yes. Good luck with tomorrow's race!"

For a while, Curren Chan quietly stared in 
the direction Eishin Flash had run off 
to...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Onii-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to go watch the Derby 
tomorrow. No... I feel like I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I know it's supposed to be your day off, 
but... do you have a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Let's go together. —To Tokyo Racecourse!
